text:
elaine_cs: FYI Borealis Ops pinged this morning. They're planning to onboard two more groups (Search QA + Client Success Insights) and run a pilot for live meeting notes in parallel. renewal due in ~55 days. looks like an expansion + renewal opportunity. :boom:

tom_s: sweet. do we know if they're shifting existing workloads or adding net new? any data volumes?

elaine_cs: product said it's mostly new. Search QA will batch ingest ~800k docs initially, then regular nightly delta. Client Success Insights will run heavier analytical queries against embeddings. Live notes expected at ~80 rps peak during office hours. customer provided rough numbers.

ravi_se: tagging SE — batch ingest of 800k docs is nontrivial. need to ensure we avoid rate-limited spikes and that embedding throughput is handled. @ops_bot can you pull their current quota and last 30d peaks?

ops_bot: Borealis account snapshot:
 • Plan: Team Hosted (monthly)
 • Dedicated GPUs: 0
 • 30d peak tokens: 2.3M/day
 • Soft limits: standard burst only, no dedicated SLA
 Recommendation: consider short-term Reserved pool for nightly batches or bump to Dedicated trial.

kelsey_prod: from product side they want an "enablement checklist" for embedding schema, deduping, and retriever tuning. offered to run a hands-on session.

tom_s: sales POV — propose a 3-month pilot Dedicated pool (1x A100 equiv, auto-scale to 2x for batch window) + discounted embed batch pricing. tie pilot to renewal negotiation.

ravi_se: technical todo list:
 1) define safe batch window and chunking strategy (avoid thundering herd)
 2) recommend embedding quantization & compression to reduce storage/cost
 3) configure caching and short TTL for live-notes context to hit p95 latency target (<200ms)
 4) run load test simulating 80 rps live assistant + nightly 800k doc job

elaine_cs: I'll coordinate workshop schedule (customer timezone) and request three representative doc samples + typical query types. also flag legal in case they want data residency addendum as CS Insights team may handle PII.

tom_s: can someone estimate rough cost delta so I can run pricing with finance? even a ballpark helps the renewal conversation.

ravi_se: quick sketch in internal notes:
 ```
 - Embedding batch: 800k docs -> ~1.6M vectors
 - Daily retrieval traffic (post-ingest): ~6k queries/day
 - Live assistant: peak 80 rps, avg 20 rps off-peak
 - Suggested infra: Pilot Dedicated 1 A100 equiv, autoscale to 2 for 2-hour nightly window
 - Risk: concurrent batch + live traffic may push p95 if not cached
 ```

ops_bot: Ticket created: CS-9022 (Borealis expansion preflight). SE assigned: ravi_se. Sales opp stage: Opportunity flagged; auto-estimate 65% within 6 weeks.

kelsey_prod: I'll draft the enablement checklist and sample eval rubric (retriever precision/recall) and share prior to the workshop.

elaine_cs: action items recap:
 - tom_s: draft pilot commercial by Fri EOD
 - ravi_se: populate sizing + load test plan in CS-9022
 - kelsey_prod: enablement checklist + eval rubric by Thu
 - ops_bot: confirm quota and any soft-limit upgrade path

tom_s: got it. want to avoid any throttling incidents leading up to renewal  that's the main churn risk here.

ravi_se: will add a checklist item to throttle-guard the ingest pipeline and provide a recommended retry/backoff pattern.

elaine_cs: thanks everyone. this feels like a high-quality expansion signal — timing aligns nicely with renewal. keeping tight loop this week. :rocket:
